author: Pros-Link
//dependencies: Anything `next build` needs lives here, not in devDependencies. npm omits devDependencies whenever NODE_ENV=production, and hosting panels apply that variable to the install step as well as the running app — which produces an install that reports success followed by a build that dies on a missing Tailwind plugin. Since this project is built on the host it is deployed to, its build tools are production dependencies in practice. The cost is disk in node_modules; the alternative is a deploy that fails depending on one environment variable.
